name: Settle private investment cash flows at closing (one closing or follow-on cash flow)
summary: When a direct private investment closes, a loan is drawn or a follow-on investment or sale settles, the direct private investment operations team moves the money through the fund's holding subsidiaries and the custodian. Analysts set up the investment in the private investments system, check the funds flow against the approval and documents, a senior associate verifies every payee's wire instructions by calling a known contact, the payment is keyed by one person and approved by two authorised signatories, and it is released on the closing call before the payment cut-off. Afterwards the transaction is booked, fund accounting posts the entries and cash is reconciled to the custodian statement. Large irrevocable wires make the process a target for spoofed instructions, and late funds flow changes and slipping closing dates create most of the rework.

baseline.org_archetype: A Canadian national pension fund investment manager with about 2,000 employees that makes large direct private investments through holding subsidiaries and settles cash through a global custodian.
baseline.notes: Modelled on the model fund fiscal 2020 to 2022; payment limits and system names are not public and are generic.

unit_of_work: one closing or follow-on cash flow
trigger: Legal sends a closing funds request with the funds flow memo for a closing, or the credit team sends a drawdown, repayment or follow-on funding request.
end_state: The payment or receipt has settled, is booked in the private investments system, posted by fund accounting and reconciled to the custodian statement; or the payment is blocked as suspected fraud or cancelled because the deal terminated.

volume.seasonality: More closings in the last weeks before calendar year end and before March 31.

evidence.note: Taken from the organisation file's process map (28 to 55 a month), based on about 20 closings a month plus loan drawdowns, repayments and follow-on fundings.

systems.name: Private investments administration and cash flow system
Global custodian web portal and statements
SWIFT messaging to custodians and banks
SimCorp Dimension investment book of record (portfolio accounting, treasury, performance)
Document management and investment committee memo repository

steps.name: Receive the closing funds request and open a case
steps.description: A direct operations analyst receives the funds request from Legal or the credit team with the funds flow memo, payee wire instruction letters and the expected closing date, logs it in the closings tracker and confirms which holding subsidiary pays or receives.

error.defect_description: Wrong paying entity or closing date recorded.

evidence.note: Operations assist closings through documentation review and system set-ups (posting); investments are held through holding subsidiaries (F2022). Split between new and existing set-ups estimated.

steps.name: Set up the investment, entity and counterparty records
steps.description: The analyst creates the investment, the holding subsidiary's interest, the issuer or borrower and the payee in the private investments system, attaches the signed documents and enters commitment, currency, ownership and fee terms for later bookings.

error.defect_description: Commitment, currency or ownership keyed wrongly.

evidence.note: System set-ups and transaction entries named in the posting; effort estimated.

steps.name: Check the funds flow against the approval and documents
steps.description: The analyst compares the amounts, currencies, payees, paying entities and purpose in the funds flow memo with the approval decision, the signed agreements and the tax review, recalculates totals and withholding, and notes any mismatch.

error.defect_description: A mismatch between funds flow and agreement is missed.

control.basis: Payments must match an approved transaction and its signed documents (management authorities)

evidence.note: Check content follows the closing workflow's funds flow and tax review; discrepancy rate and split of payments and receipts estimated.

steps.name: Query the deal team and counsel on discrepancies
steps.description: The analyst emails the deal team and counsel with the discrepancy list, waits for a corrected funds flow or an explanation, and updates the tracker.

evidence.note: Query cycle and response time estimated.

steps.name: Verify payee wire instructions by call-back
steps.description: A senior associate calls the payee's known contact on a number taken from the counterparty record or an independent source, never from the instruction letter or email, confirms the bank, account and beneficiary name, and records who confirmed and when.

control.basis: Wire fraud controls: verify payment instructions and changes through a separate, previously validated channel

next.condition: instructions changed or cannot be confirmed

evidence.note: IC3, First Citizens and Latham & Watkins recommend outbound call-backs to known contacts; share of changed or unconfirmed instructions estimated.

steps.name: Resolve changed or unverifiable instructions
steps.description: The private investment operations director reviews instructions that changed late or could not be confirmed, has counsel confirm them with the counterparty's lawyers, involves information security if the email looks spoofed, and either clears a re-verification or blocks the payment.

control.basis: Two-person approval of changes to payment instructions

evidence.note: Two approvers for payment instruction changes; BEC exposed losses of US$43.3 billion show the stakes. Outcome shares estimated.

steps.name: Arrange funding, FX and the cash forecast
steps.description: The analyst tells the liquidity team the amount, currency and value date so it enters the cash forecast, books or requests the FX trade if the payment is in another currency, and instructs funding of the paying holding subsidiary's account from the parent.

error.defect_description: Wrong value date or currency in the forecast or FX request.

evidence.note: Funding through holding subsidiaries (F2022) and forecast hand-off to liquidity are modelled on the capital calls workflow; effort estimated.

steps.name: Create the payment instruction
steps.description: The analyst keys the wire in the custodian's payment portal or the SWIFT interface from the verified instructions: debit account, amount, currency, value date, beneficiary bank and account, and the reference counsel expects.

error.defect_description: Amount, account or value date keyed wrongly.

evidence.note: Payment entry by a maker is standard practice; effort estimated.

steps.name: Review the payment as checker
steps.description: A senior associate compares the keyed payment with the funds flow, the call-back record and the approval, checks the value date against the closing date and the payment system cut-off, and approves it in the portal as first authorised signatory or rejects it.

error.defect_description: A keying error passes the review.

control.basis: Maker-checker: the person who keys a payment cannot approve it

evidence.note: Separation of initiation and approval (First Citizens); wire payments are irrevocable once processed (Fedwire). Rejection rate estimated.

steps.name: Director gives the second authorised approval
steps.description: The private investment operations director reviews the payment, the supporting funds flow and verification evidence, and gives the second authorisation required by the bank mandate, or sends it back.

control.basis: Banking resolutions and signing authorities: two authorised approvers for each wire

evidence.note: Two authorised approvals are in the process map description; payment limits and shares estimated.

steps.name: Head of investment operations approves a very large payment
steps.description: For payments above the director's limit the Managing Director, Head of Investment Operations reviews the pack and adds the approval required by the payment authority matrix.

control.basis: Payment authority matrix: extra approval above a dollar threshold

evidence.note: Banks can require phone authorisation above a threshold (Latham & Watkins); the organisation has a head of investment operations. Threshold and share estimated.

steps.name: Release the payment on closing confirmation
steps.description: On the closing day the senior associate waits for counsel to confirm on the closing call that conditions are met and signatures are released, then releases the pre-approved wire before the payment system cut-off and emails the reference to counsel.

evidence.note: Same-day cut-offs for large-value payments (Fedwire); closings wait for conditions to be met. Wait from approval to the closing date estimated.

steps.name: Hold and re-date the payment for a delayed closing
steps.description: When the closing slips the analyst cancels or holds the wire, re-dates the funding and FX, updates the cash forecast and re-submits the payment for approval when a new date is set; a terminated deal is closed out.

evidence.note: Delays and terminations estimated from the closing workflow, where some approved deals never close.

steps.name: Custodian executes the wire
steps.description: The custodian bank screens and sends the payment through the high-value payment system and its correspondent network to the beneficiary bank.

evidence.note: Real-time gross settlement of large-value payments; custodian processing time estimated.

steps.name: Confirm receipt and finality of the payment
steps.description: The analyst checks the custodian status and the payment reference, gets confirmation from counsel or the escrow agent that funds arrived, and updates the closings tracker.

evidence.note: Return and delay rate estimated.

steps.name: Investigate a returned or delayed wire
steps.description: A senior associate traces the payment with the custodian and the correspondent bank, corrects beneficiary details through a fresh verified instruction if needed, and re-sends it.

evidence.note: Investigation effort estimated.

steps.name: Record the transaction in the private investments system
steps.description: The analyst books the cash flow against the investment: cost or proceeds, fees and expenses, commitment drawn or repaid, and ownership change, and attaches the funds flow, approvals and confirmations.

error.defect_description: Cost and fees split wrongly or booked to the wrong entity.

evidence.note: Transaction entries and record reconciliation named in the posting; effort estimated.

steps.name: Prepare accounting entries and support for fund accounting
steps.description: The analyst generates the accounting entries from the booking, maps them to the holding subsidiary and investment, and sends the support pack (funds flow, wire confirmation, agreement extracts) to fund accounting.

error.defect_description: Entry mapped to the wrong ledger account.

evidence.note: Hand-off to investment accounting estimated from the accounting workflow, which lists these entries as a trigger.

steps.name: Fund accounting reviews and posts the entries
steps.description: A fund accounting senior associate checks the entries against the support and the ledger, posts them to the investment book of record and returns any errors to operations.

control.basis: Internal control over financial reporting: independent review before posting

evidence.note: Review and posting timing estimated.

steps.name: Reconcile cash to the custodian statement and close the case
steps.description: The analyst matches the payment or receipt on the custodian cash statement to the booking and the funds flow, clears any difference and closes the case in the tracker.

control.basis: Cash reconciliation separated from payment initiation and approval

evidence.note: Separation of approval and reconciliation (First Citizens); reconciling records (posting).

steps.name: Send the receiving account details and confirm them by call
steps.description: For proceeds the senior associate sends the holding subsidiary's receiving account details on letterhead to the buyer's counsel or agent and confirms them by phone so the payer can verify them, guarding against spoofed instructions.

control.basis: Wire fraud controls: payment details confirmed through a separate channel

evidence.note: Secondary-channel verification of account information (IC3); parties agree how banking details are circulated and verified (Latham & Watkins).

steps.name: Monitor and match incoming proceeds
steps.description: On the closing or repayment date the analyst watches the custodian account for the incoming wire, matches the amount and reference to the funds flow, and tells the liquidity team when cash arrives.

evidence.note: Timing and exception rate estimated.

steps.name: Chase late or short proceeds
steps.description: A senior associate contacts the buyer's agent or borrower and the custodian to trace the missing or short payment and agrees when the balance will arrive.

evidence.note: Effort estimated.

exceptions.name: Funds flow discrepancy
exceptions.description: Amounts, payees or entities in the funds flow do not match the approval or the signed agreements, and counsel or the deal team must correct the memo.

exceptions.name: Changed or unverifiable wire instructions
exceptions.description: A payee's bank details change late or cannot be confirmed by call-back; the director has counsel confirm them, and suspected spoofing blocks the payment.

exceptions.name: Very large payment
exceptions.description: The amount is above the director's payment limit and the head of investment operations adds an approval, often on the closing day.

exceptions.name: Closing delayed or terminated
exceptions.description: Conditions are not met on the expected date; funding, FX and the wire are re-dated, and occasionally the deal terminates.

exceptions.name: Returned or late wire
exceptions.description: A correspondent bank returns or holds the payment and it must be traced and re-sent.

exceptions.name: Booking error found by fund accounting
exceptions.description: Fund accounting returns entries with cost, fee or entity errors for correction before posting.

benchmarks.unit: calendar days from funds request received to cash reconciled and case closed
benchmarks.population: Direct private investment closings and loan cash flows at a large pension investment manager

evidence.note: Estimate: funds requests usually arrive a few days before closing (the closing workflow allows about two days between request and closing call), plus one to three days to post and reconcile.

benchmarks.unit: USD exposed losses, June 2016 to December 2021
benchmarks.population: Business email compromise incidents reported worldwide

evidence.note: 241,206 incidents.

benchmarks.unit: deadline for third-party transfers each business day

evidence.note: Business day ends 19:00 ET.

benchmarks.population: The model fund investment holding subsidiaries

evidence.note: C$44,244 million a year earlier; future drawdowns flow through this process or capital calls.

pain_points.description: Funds flow memos are finalised days or hours before closing and change late, forcing re-checks, re-keying and new approvals under time pressure.

evidence.note: Estimate based on the closing workflow's late funds flow review.

pain_points.description: Spoofed or changed wire instructions are a constant risk on large irrevocable payments, and call-backs depend on reaching the right person in time.

evidence.note: US$43.3 billion exposed BEC losses; payments final once processed.

pain_points.description: Approvers must be available on the closing day before the payment cut-off, often across time zones.

evidence.note: Same-day cut-offs for large-value payments.

pain_points.description: The same deal data are typed into the private investments system, the payment portal and the accounting entries, so keying errors surface late at posting or reconciliation.

evidence.note: Set-ups, transaction entries and reconciliation are separate tasks in the posting.

sources.publisher: Federal Bureau of Investigation, Internet Crime Complaint Center
sources.supports: 241,206 domestic and international BEC incidents and US$43.3 billion exposed losses from June 2016 to December 2021; verify requests to change account information through secondary channels or two-factor authentication; review accounts for irregularities.

sources.title: Funds transfer fraud prevention
sources.supports: Call back on a previously validated number and never use contact details in the request; two people approve changes to payment instructions; separate initiation, approval and recording; pause and validate under time pressure; private fund example of a fraudulent distribution wire after an emailed bank change.

sources.supports: Real-time gross settlement used for large-value, time-critical payments; transfers are immediate, final and irrevocable once processed; business day ends 7:00 p.m. ET with a 6:45 p.m. ET deadline for third-party transfers.

sources.title: Sale processes
sources.supports: Closing follows signing once regulatory approvals and conditions are met, a few weeks for private companies and over a year with significant regulatory hurdles.

sources.title: The pervasive threat of business email compromise fraud and how to prevent it (Client Alert 2590)
sources.supports: Payer should always verify banking instructions by an outbound phone call to a known contact at the payee; agree the verification procedure at the start of each transaction; treat changed payment details with extra suspicion; require phone authorisation with banks above a threshold. assumptions: Trigger shares (55% closings from Legal, 45% loan drawdowns, repayments and follow-ons from Credit) are estimates; the process map gives no split.
About 82% of cases are payments and 18% receipts; receipts skip the call-back, maker-checker and approval steps but confirm the fund's own receiving details by phone.
The approval decision is listed as a standing input because the funds flow is checked against it; it does not start a case.
The director's payment limit, the head of investment operations' approval tier and the shares of exceptions are estimates; the organisation does not publish its payment authorities.
The case clock includes the wait from payment approval to the closing date, which depends on how early Legal sends the request.
Loaded hourly costs come from the organisation file (overhead factor 1.25).
